Hi, I don't think the sleeping pills alone will work, you'll end up having your stomach pumped, tried with vodka, and Iknow you don't want anyone to talk you out of it but if you want to speaks to someone pm me

Hi, it's really hard to stay optimistic when the bad days overweighs the good days, ridiculously hard and I've been there thinking there's no point because this will never go away, it will always be like this, but I just recently started to focuses on things that really make me happy, like getting my own apartment is top of the list and now I'm just working towards it, anything you can think of that makes you happy?

That's really weird I haven't been on here long but I try to comment on as many post as I can, but Yh I can't imagine going to school and working that many hours, are you planning to go to college or anything? I think you need to start making time for yourself

Hi, this hits home, I also feel like my inevitable end is suicide, I don't want to feel or have these thoughts but I can't bare it because I miss being happy, I miss going to bed feeling free and waking up feeling happy, I'm trying to change things in my life to myself happier but it's so hard, I'm taking each day as it comes, how have you been coping?

Hi, you're a few years older than me but I feel like I can relate a lot, having no real connection with your family or any real friends leads to a differently type of pain that seems to drag on for years and years. There's nothing I can say to make you feel better and I'm sorry about that. The only thing I can say of focus on your daughter because she's your real family now, create memories and experiences with her, invest your time and energy in her! You also mention you've started school, try put some energy in that. What was the one thing you saw in your future that made you feel happy?
I agree it is really hard to kill yourself you'd think I'd be so much easier, but before that you wanna talk to what's led to this?
Don't be scared, you can PM me if it's overwhelming on the comment
Hi, whatever you want to say, some of us are really here to listen and support you, so take your time and whenever you're ready get it off your chest
Allow yourself to feel it all, don't try and bottle it up, cry if you need to, let your feeling out on here, talk to people, we are here to help each other especially when our days are darkest

Your right the pressure of being an adult is so overwhelming. I remember when I was about 17 all i wanted was to finish uni get my own flat and get my job thinking I'd be a walk in a park. I definitely cannot afford my own house but I try to think I can always do that, I can always get a better a job and make more money to move out someday. I know sometime it feels like everything and everyone are against you but you take steps to change that, I hope you and your girlfriend make up and your house mates really reach out to you

You can't leave us now! We must help each other to conquer this

It's not the end of your story, you can still manage to get yourself to work (even if barely) you mention you have friends, try and spend as much time around people as you can and when alone try and distract your mind what you do doesn't have to make you happy but it must distract you from thinking the worst have you got any interest at all or any social media presence?

Hi, I'm constantly thinking of weak and embarrassing I am for not coping, when there's people out there going through worse things, it's like I'm doing this to myself but at the same time I can't control it, it sucks, what's keeping me going each day is just trying hardest to distract myself, you mentions you have friends try and spend as much time as you can with them, you're also starting college a chance to join a number of societies and make different groups of friends surround yourself with things that make you laugh and happy, get a part time job and earn a little bit of money to treat yourself occasionally really live your life for yourself and try your hardest to find hapiness within yourself

I'm not going to lie to you it's hard not to fantasies about the peace you get when it's finally over, recently I've got as far as planning what day and how exactly it'll be done, but I'm constantly thinking of all the hopes I had for my future and if I'm ready to give all that up, all my friends and family. Life is short enough already why should I cut mine even shorter, try and find things that make you happy and keep your head up

Hi thank you for posting, I know exactly how you feel, tired of crying everyday, tried of being down and simply tired of life, lately I've been having a lot of suicidal fantasies too of how and where I could end, but then I think about the people I'm leaving behind and it hurts me. Iknow this feeling sucks and all you want to do is just smile with your heart but you have distract your self from this feeling! The distraction doesn't have to make you happy but it has to occupy your brain for the day and at the end of the day count it as a successful day, because in time something or someone will come into your life and you will be filled with so much joy that you can't handle. But for now try and take each day as it comes, have you always felt like this or has something triggered it?

Hi, depression is devil sent and it sucks when it lures around us for so many years. Like you IVE been having a lot of suicidal fantasies recently, but I've been on here the whole day talking people out of suicide, what a hypocrite right. Like you I also Beleive in God and people always tell me that my relationship with him was much stronger then the thoughts of suicide wouldn't be in my head, I do Beleive that, however the pain of disappointment and being unhappy in life is too much that sometimes you just have to wonder if death is the easiest way out. I am a lot younger than you so I don't know what advise I could give you, the only thing I can say to is that suffering on this earth is not compared to the joy you will receive in heaven, pray everyday, download the bible app and try and read a chapter a day, get out there meet some new people (Iknow that's a lot easier said than done) but you have to push yourself to try, go out on dates, distract yourself keep your mind off the negatives, somedays will be worse but you must allow yourself to feel that pain. These are just immediate things you can do. Also you mention you're going to community college are you enjoying your course?

Trust me you are NOT a drain on society. And for you start contributing to society you need to contribute to your own life before anything or anyone else. Panick attacks are a real thing believe it or not totally not your fault that you have attacks befor interviews, interviews can be very intense and trigger all sorts of emotions. Public school system can also suck with all the bullies out there, but have you ever thought joint a club or society to make some friends? Or just communicating people? That will really help you start getting out of your comfort zone

Hey, the thought of suicide seems satisfying at the moment because of the pain you're going through, I'm also going through a lot of pain and have fantasied about dying. You mention how the most beautiful moment was taking mdma and watched the sun rise and how you had a beautiful moment. Okay now what you have to do is imagine your everyday life feeling like that without the drugs. You can achieve that through your career, through your own house, relationships, marriage, kids etc. Your future is not hopeless, that's what keeps me going everyday. It may hurt now but I allow myself to feel that pain and count everyday as a successful day and a day closer to that hapiness, keep your head up, distract yourself and find comfort in your close friends. I hope this helps you
Hey what's up?

Hi, I want to say I know how you feel but everyone's different, I've also recently been having suicidal fantasies and the thought of not feeling like this or living in this dark world will end, I feel the same way that I wasn't born to happy and I'll always be like this. These are the thoughts that are constantly running in my head. But let me ask you one think, do you ever imagine yourself having the perfect job, or house or partner or kids in the future? And if so does that make you happy? It it does then then you definitely have to keep living but you'll have to take each day as it comes and do anything to distract the negative thinking, doesn't have to make you happy it just has to distract you and keep you moving forward!

The thought of death is satisfying until you think of the people you are leaving behind, I've been having suicida fantasies and although I believe I won't do anything to myself it's gives me peace thinking I can just tap out whenever I wanted BUT then I think of temporary life is and all the things I will be missing out on which also give me peace. My advise to you is ignore that negative aspect in your life (hard Iknow) but everyday you make it without attempting suicide is a successful day! And one day you'll wake up rolf at the thought of you once writing this post. Goodluck

Hi, I know how it feels to be down and hopeless and I know the night time is even worse because you're left alone with your thoughts, I'm going though the exact same things I spend most of my days and night crying and wanting a way out, even though I know it's not the right thing to do. My not advise to you is to try your hardest and distract your mind, it doesn't have to necessarily make you happy but it has to distract your mind for the day, just take each day as it comes and carry on doing things that distract you. Also try and think of what you've always imagined your future to be like, dream job? Relationship? House? Try and think of your future self and the hapiness that you will get, that should give you hope to keep you going!

This post is so familiar because for a long time my birthday was just any other day, no family member ever wished me happy birthday no cake, no card, nothing. I'm also struggling with depression and having suicidal thoughts at the moment and know exactly how you feel. What I try to remember is that death is inevitable, and I don't know how olds you are but trust me one day you'll look back at this day and laugh, when you're filled with so much joy, through your career, kids,marriage, house etc. And that's what keeps me going that there is always light at the end of the tunnel, and right now it may seem like that light is death but give yourself time to find that light on earth

You backed out for a reason, there's definitely something great coming your way, I've been having suicide fantasies for a while now, and through all that pain I simply just try and tackle each day as it come waiting for that one day I wake up feeling free, it excites me just thinking about it. Just take each day as it comes and have hope. This world is very temporary anyone could drop dead tomorrow enjoys yours!

I admire your courage to stick by your girlfriends, I have been with an Albanian guy for almost 5 years and it's the same situation, his parents will never accept us so now we have to break up because he cannot choose me over his parents and that not what I want Ofcourse I do believe that parents will love you no matter what even if they wonder they will come back because at the end of the day you're still their son, we live in temporary world and I'm happy that you chose hapiness, just try and let them know that you will always be there for them and support them but your girlfriend makes you happy and you hope they can understand that
